title: Charm Unlock
tagline: Twist the rings, set the charms free.
trayFullText: Try releasing the same colors one after another.
devNote: Development build. Tap the board once to enable sound.
hint.tut1: Drag a ring to turn it. Bring its gap to where it crosses a neighbour. A glowing ring is free: tap it.
hint.tut2: 3 charms of the same color merge in the tray. If all 5 slots fill up, you lose. Each turn costs 1 move; tapping is free.
hint.new_pin: A pinned ring only comes off when its gap sits on the pin.
hint.new_fixed: A bolted ring cannot turn. Free it with its neighbours’ gaps.
hint.new_twin: This ring has two gaps: one turn can open two crossings.
hint.new_lock: A locked ring stays until the first triple merges in the tray. Make a triple first.
hint.new_ice: An ice ring turns only twice. Watch the counter!
hint.normal: Which ring opens the way for the others?
hint.hard: Hard level! Don’t release in an order that fills the tray.
hint.relief: Take a breath: an easy bracelet.
hint.super: Super hard! No spare moves: every turn must count.
dailyText: Open the game any day to get the next reward. Missed days don’t reset it.
trayRescue: Use a Magnet or an Extra slot to save it.
no.slot: Extra slot is already open this level
